project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 1 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Elan Village
townGuide.intro: Elan Village has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Elan Village Stone Bridge
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Elan Village Stone Bridge and Elan Village Suspension Bridge, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
